projects.title: Geotagging App — Field Monitoring Platform
projects.description: A web and mobile platform for geotagging monitored government projects, with real-time upload to a central dashboard. I contribute to development and debugging, and train Operations Division users on it.

projects.title: Virtual Biobank — 3D Specimen Digitization
projects.description: A 3D walkthrough of digitized insect specimens, built with JavaScript and A-Frame on a C#/.NET and PostgreSQL back end. Specimens are captured via photogrammetry and organized with metadata templates and taxonomy standards.

projects.title: Automated Pin Holder — 3D Insect Imaging
projects.description: An ESP32-based automated pin holder that supports image capture of insect specimens for photogrammetry. Developed with the project team as part of the biobanking work, combining a microcontroller, mechanical parts, and software.

projects.title: EDSS Monitoring Website
projects.description: A web tool tracking implementation of six Enterprise Development Sustainability Support projects under the RCEF Mechanization Program, built to support reporting across farmers' cooperatives, LGUs, and other stakeholders.

paragraphs: I'm an IT graduate and application developer with 3+ years at PhilMech (Department of Agriculture), where I've moved through four roles across three divisions — from consolidating farm machinery data by hand to now writing functional specs, running UAT, and maintaining systems as a Computer Programmer I.

Along the way I've automated a 30,000-row reporting workflow with Excel VBA and Apps Script (cutting about two days of manual work), digitized specimens through photogrammetry, helped build an ESP32-based pin holder that automates specimen imaging, and built the 3D web environments that display them. I like translating field needs into clear specs just as much as writing the code itself.
